blurb: Beat ledgers, collections and a daily close for your agency
intro: If you supply retailers on fixed beats, you need a ledger for each beat, collections matched to the bill, and a daily close that reconciles cash, UPI and credit. BolCash is built for that.
name: FMCG distributor

uses.body: A separate ledger for each beat or route, so one salesman's collections never mix with another's.
uses.title: Beat ledger

uses.body: Collections matched to the retailer's bill, including UPI payments, reconciled by hand against the bill.
uses.title: Beat collections

uses.body: Close each beat at day-end, and make GST invoices with an export for your CA and Tally.
uses.title: Daily close and GST
